Hi <@!311126836371259402> how are you connecting to the attacknet? and what issue do you have <@!399309815517544451> ```bazel run //beacon-chain -- --datadir=$HOME/.eth2 --chain-config-file ~/public-attacknets/attacknets/prysm-attack-0/prysm_config.yaml --no-discovery --min-sync-peers=1 --bootstrap-node=enr:-LK4QLQJ7VaRRbrW3jE9fRR-gfKKduK74xSvMQAke_KcEKMOGLtJYy6y97fAtCd9Ou1KxRcl68BsM_LemY8f1Bh80XABh2F0dG5ldHOIAAAAAAAAAACEZXRoMpDDVKVKAAAAAP__________gmlkgnY0gmlwhBK3DPCJc2VjcDI1NmsxoQMLKPinmDnROP9TPUG0R-LdCpv-X9hxRS8G4rCrJ7hQuoN0Y3CCIyiDdWRwgiMo --clear-db --contract-deployment-block 3076295 --deposit-contract "0x0d9d6d3aa0791d3b3f4f489b46dcd2586c1011c4"``` cant sync: `initial-sync: Waiting for enough suitable peers before syncing required=1 suitable=0` anything interesting at the debug level? you have `--no-discovery` as a flag 🙂 oh that will do it lol You wont be able to find any peers with that flag okay, then it probably does something different than the lighthouse flag... how to connect to exactly 1 node? `--no-discovery` disables all discovery, it would only peer with peers that you specify specifically use `--peer` flag to define 1 node yeah ^ `--no-discovery --peer=<peer address>` <@!476250636548308992> is it multiaddress or ENR? both is fine ok cool so put the ENR there or the libp2p multiaddr if you have it thanks 🙂 works now great! <@!363800010518822915> sorry, it is back online now https://prysm-attack-0.beaconcha.in/

excerpts.content: and what issue do you have

excerpts.author: phil.eth
excerpts.content: <@!399309815517544451> ```bazel run //beacon-chain -- --datadir=$HOME/.eth2 --chain-config-file ~/public-attacknets/attacknets/prysm-attack-0/prysm_config.yaml --no-discovery --min-sync-peers=1 --bootstrap-node=enr:-LK4QLQJ7VaRRbrW3jE9fRR-gfKKduK74xSvMQAke_KcEKMOGLtJYy6y97fAtCd9Ou1KxRcl68BsM_LemY8f1Bh80XABh2F0dG5ldHOIAAAAAAAAAACEZXRoMpDDVKVKAAAAAP__________gmlkgnY0gmlwhBK3DPCJc2VjcDI1NmsxoQMLKPinmDnROP9TPUG0R-LdCpv-X9hxRS8G4rCrJ7hQuoN0Y3CCIyiDdWRwgiMo --clear-db --contract-deployment-block 3076295 --deposit-contract "0x0d9d6d3aa0791d3b3f4f489b46dcd2586c1011c4"```

excerpts.author: phil.eth
excerpts.content: cant sync: `initial-sync: Waiting for enough suitable peers before syncing required=1 suitable=0`

excerpts.author: prestonvanloon
excerpts.content: anything interesting at the debug level?

excerpts.author: nishant0
excerpts.content: you have `--no-discovery` as a flag 🙂

excerpts.author: prestonvanloon
excerpts.content: oh that will do it lol

excerpts.author: nishant0
excerpts.content: You wont be able to find any peers with that flag

excerpts.author: phil.eth
excerpts.content: okay, then it probably does something different than the lighthouse flag...

excerpts.author: phil.eth
excerpts.content: how to connect to exactly 1 node?

excerpts.author: prestonvanloon
excerpts.content: `--no-discovery` disables all discovery, it would only peer with peers that you specify specifically

excerpts.author: prestonvanloon
excerpts.content: use `--peer` flag

excerpts.author: prestonvanloon
excerpts.content: to define 1 node

excerpts.author: nishant0
excerpts.content: yeah ^

excerpts.author: prestonvanloon
excerpts.content:
`--no-discovery --peer=<peer address>`

<@!476250636548308992> is it multiaddress or ENR?

excerpts.author: nishant0
excerpts.content: both is fine

excerpts.author: prestonvanloon
excerpts.content: ok cool so put the ENR there or the libp2p multiaddr if you have it

excerpts.author: phil.eth
excerpts.content: thanks 🙂
